task: Task 8 - checkpoint recovery and atomic QA publish
assertions: Successful checkpoint batches are not claimed again after a resumed QA split run.
A failed checkpoint batch does not publish or replace ACTIVE QA pairs.
All checkpoint batches must succeed before QaPair replacement and EMBEDDING transition.
Pending QA split checkpoint payloads are not returned by EmbeddingService QA-pair queries.
A QA model-name change cancels the incomplete run and creates a replacement run.
